fields.Front: Seven rules, Step 1: how are regular entity types mapped?
fields.Back: Create a relation with all simple attributes (only simple components of composites); choose one key attribute of the entity as primary key (if composite, its simple attributes together form the PK).

fields.Front: Seven rules, Step 2: how are weak entity types mapped?
fields.Back: Create a relation with the weak entity's simple attributes plus the owner's primary key as a foreign key; PK = owner's PK + the weak entity's partial key (if any).

fields.Front: Seven rules, Step 3: how are binary 1:1 relationships mapped?
fields.Back: Pick one of the two relations S (preferably the one with total participation) and include the PK of the other, T, as a foreign key in S; include the relationship's simple attributes in S.

fields.Front: Seven rules, Step 4: how are binary 1:N relationships mapped?
fields.Back: Include the PK of the 1-side relation as a foreign key in the N-side relation S (each N-side entity relates to at most one 1-side entity); include the relationship's simple attributes in S.

fields.Front: Seven rules, Step 5: how are binary M:N relationships mapped?
fields.Back: Create a new relation S with the PKs of both participating relations as foreign keys; their combination is the PK of S; include the relationship's simple attributes.

fields.Front: Seven rules, Step 6: how are multi-valued attributes mapped?
fields.Back: Create a new relation R with an attribute for A plus the PK K of the owning relation as a foreign key; PK of R = (A, K); if A is composite include its simple components.

fields.Front: Seven rules, Step 7: how are n-ary relationships (n > 2) mapped?
fields.Back: Create a new relation S with the PKs of all participating relations as foreign keys; their combination is the PK; include the relationship's simple attributes.

fields.Text: The seven mapping steps in order: 1 {{c1::regular entities}}, 2 {{c2::weak entities}}, 3 {{c3::binary 1:1}}, 4 {{c4::binary 1:N}}, 5 {{c5::binary M:N}}, 6 {{c6::multi-valued attributes}}, 7 {{c7::n-ary relationships}}.
Mapping steps that create new tables: {{c1::1, 2, 5, 6 and 7}}; steps that only add foreign-key columns to existing tables: {{c2::3 and 4}}.
